answer: Lotus-thread attestation cycle.** Each identity must sustain a public thread of small, verified interactions with three rotating peers over consecutive epochs; peers confirm the work, not the person. Saffron marks are earned only through completed threads, and new identities need a saffron balance to enter pools. Attacker cost: maintaining N identities means N concurrent work schedules, since missed confirmations break threads and reset progress, making cloning linearly laborious rather than cheap.
